clues.text: After bearing six sons to Jacob, Leah gave birth to this daughter and named her.
While Jacob camped near a city in Canaan, his daughter went out to visit the daughters of the land.
The son of Hamor the Hivite loved this daughter of Jacob and spoke to her tenderly.
When Jacob heard his daughter had been defiled, he kept silent until his sons came in from the field.
Her brothers deceitfully said she could marry only if every male of the prince's city was circumcised.
Simeon and Levi took their swords, killed the men of a city, and brought their sister out.
Jacob's daughter, counted with Leah's sons born in Paddan-aram, thirty-three sons and daughters in all.
